job.title: [Post] Hiring for an E-Commerce Digital Transformation? SAP Hybris ...

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Consultant | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Consultant and Backend Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and digital transformations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211). Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer combining technical depth with business analysis and stakeholder management.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris Consultant
cover_en.hook: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and techno-functional consultant driving enterprise e-commerce digital transformation initiatives, I am very excited about this opportunity. Across 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have successfully designed, built, and integrated large-scale SAP Hybris platforms connecting complex PIM, ERP, and MDM systems.

bullets.label: SAP Hybris & Digital Transformation
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) for global e-commerce channels, aligning technical architectures with business objectives.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Bridged business and IT by analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and collaborating closely with international stakeholders and product owners.

bullets.label: API & System Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure seamless enterprise data flow.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization & Support
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, managed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and resolved complex integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce layers.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how my SAP Hybris expertise can contribute to your digital transformation projects.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce (Hybris) expertise to drive successful e-commerce digital transformations. My experience bridging business requirements with robust technical implementations at Rockwell Automation and Shell makes me an ideal fit to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong API integration skills, and techno-functional expertise to accelerate your e-commerce digital transformation projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and techno-functional SAP Hybris Consultant with 5+ years of enterprise experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am currently serving a notice period ending 15.12.2026 and would love to discuss how I can support your digital transformation initiatives.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Hybris Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Hybris Consultant position. With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP integrations, and techno-functional consulting.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
